author: Proper_Succotash_351
body:
Absolutely not. I'm a 240 GS with a fully upgraded celestial weapon and good gear, and I still hate this fight. 

Few suggestions - Definitely unlock the T9 Summoner Auriga class first. It gives Mighty Griffin, which will be your go to for quite a long time. Run Mighty Griffin & Ancient Jinn, hit Ward Of Ortanite and them spam Buggane. For fights like this one, a lot of times I will just summon dead after WOO for meat shields while my 2 start summons pick them off. 

You also need to upgrade whatever gear you have to a minimum of lvl 10. I am impressed you have nearly enough shards for GSA with low level gear to be honest. You must be a good strategist.

Second thing to unlock is a celestial weapon (quarterstaff or lute recommended to start, axe later once you unlock GSA) and then fully upgrade it. 

There are a few options for the augments. 5 promethus feet is fun, it recovers 20% Ward per turn passively.  With high Ward it makes you unbelievably hard to kill. 5 shoulders of Eos with a Grand Summoner robe/Arisen Rift Summoner plate is great but more for endless and less for towers. 

Third thing to unlock is GS Hydrus for the Ancient Dragon summon. It's the strongest summon in the game, even outpacing Great Hydra. 

Finally after that you can shoot for GSA. It's summon skill is meh, but it's GSA and can equip warrior gear. 

You already have enough shards to get T9 Summoner Auriga and a fully upgraded celestial weapon, after that you will find farming for the T10 classes to be pretty easy and fast.

......

As for the Nidhogg fight. Just switch to Beo if you have it unlocked. Beo is completely immune to the 3 Nidhoggs and the other 2 don't do much damage.

author: Widogeist
body:
It might be worthwhile to upgrade either a [Bulwark](https://playorna.com/codex/items/bulwark/) or [MGS](https://playorna.com/codex/items/mighty-griffin-shield/) for the passive dragon resistance when going against this encounter or the 3x nidhoggs; the flat 50% damage reduction to dragon damage will be helpful. 

That said, I wouldn't risk it until you get better upgraded gear.  I would avoid the tougher tower fights as a GS until you unlock some celestial classes and celestial weapons for better survivability.  Also, try to get yourself Ward of Ortanite ASAP, the 85% ward absorption makes a significant difference.

author: TheRealLuhkky
body:
Early you will just have to try and potentially lose shards or call it when you know you can't win and take what shards you can manage. 

I'm 236 GS Auriga Benefactor with 90k ward and the Fafnir line up isn't too hard anymore.   The three Nihoggs are still brutal though and if I run into them at a high tower floor it's nearly impossible. 

My suggestion is to stack as much ward as you can for now and know that once you hit t10 and get ward of ortanite you will become a tower destroyer.   Many other classes have a much harder time in towers than we do in the early t10 and even t9 phases.

Good luck fellow summoner!
